content.text:
Add socials widget: rotating handle bar for streamer's other accounts

- Server holds config (accounts, timing, appearance) as Json on User;
  rotation itself runs client-side in the overlay so no server ticking
  is needed like score/timer.
- New src/lib/socialsConfig.ts validates all input field-by-field before
  Prisma writes (never spreads caller patch), same pattern as
  scoreConfig/timerConfig.
- Dashboard editor at /dashboard/w/socials with live iframe preview;
  overlay SSE stream now also pushes socials state on connect.
- Redirect signed-in users away from /login, /signup, and the landing
  page straight to /dashboard; give the landing page real marketing copy.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
